ops.title: SECURITY (pre-release, must-fix before merge): RCE via sync registry Origin to PeerTransport sh -c

ops.text: a registry-published ChainStamp.Origin (or any peer/origin string) can NEVER cause sh -c of an arbitrary command in the production binary: fetchOrder only dials the trusted configured mesh peer set (origin reorders, never introduces a dial target), and the exec: peer-transport prefix (fetcher.go:38) is sim-only-gated
fixed on branch worktree-cred-sync-origin before the cred-sync release (db150a6); found by scoped codex on internal/hostsync/credpull.go:104 fetchOrder(chain.Origin,peers) then PeerTransport sh -c
